items.statement: The calculation uses the fixed isolated BN-AkFlu structure and explicitly records charge, multiplicity, method, basis, environment, state count, and analysis implementation.
items.expected: A reproducible protocol tied to the supplied 40-atom neutral singlet geometry is reported.

items.statement: The submission validates state ordering and energy–wavelength consistency and provides per-state hole–electron analysis for S1–S4; orbital-identity text is scored only when it is explicitly retained by the output parser.
items.expected: Validation checks are explicit and per-state. State ordering, energy–wavelength consistency and S1–S4 hole–electron records are required; missing unparsed orbital-label prose must be reported as a limitation rather than treated as a failed quantum-chemical result.

items.statement: The BN-AkFlu vertical spectrum contains a low-energy S1 with small oscillator strength and a substantially stronger S5 transition at higher energy.
items.expected: S1=2.1406 eV, 579.20 nm, f=0.0080; S5=3.6113 eV, 343.33 nm, f=1.8524, subject to declared numerical tolerance.

items.statement: The S1 hole–electron distributions have near-zero separation and substantial overlap.
